text:
maria: Heads-up — new onboard sample (nextjs-edge + SDK) is flaking in edge runtime with typing errors. Repro attached.
maria: Error: "TypeError: Class extends value undefined is not a constructor or null" but only when built for ESM + edge. Works in Node dev server.
sam: hmm. Can you paste the minimal tsconfig and package.json used?
maria: package.json: 
```
{
  "name":"redwood-sample",
  "type":"module",
  "exports":{"./sdk":"./dist/sdk.mjs"}
}
```

maria: tsconfig: 
```
{
  "compilerOptions":{
    "target":"ES2020",
    "module":"ESNext",
    "moduleResolution":"bundler",
    "jsx":"react-jsx",
    "declaration":true,
    "outDir":"dist",
    "isolatedModules":true
  }
}
```

eli: quick thought — edge bundlers (vercel/deno/edge) sometimes rewrite cjs interop and break prototype chains for compiled classes. Are you emitting downlevel helpers or relying on `esModuleInterop`? 

maria: esModuleInterop is off. We tried enabling it but then types fail for overloads in SDK surface (generics + unknown). 

jun: can you show the problematic export in SDK? usually it's an exported class with generic overloads, right?
maria: SDK has: 
```
export class Client<T = any> {
  constructor(opts: ClientOptions<T>){...}
  request<R>(path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<R> { ... }
}
```

maria: and a helper file that conditionally exports default for CJS builds. When bundler rewrites conditional export, runtime resolves to undefined.

sam: two orthogonal issues: runtime interop for ESM/CJS and typing surface where `unknown` vs `any` breaks user inference in samples. For DX let's keep types strict but provide ergonomic overloads.

eli: suggestion: emit pure ESM artifacts for edge sample (no dual cjs/esm). That avoids conditional export shims that bundlers mess up. For npm package, still provide cjs in a separate build but sample can use "exports": {"import":"./dist/sdk.mjs"} 

jun: on the typing side — change request signature to help inference: 
```
request<T = unknown>(path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T>
```
and add convenience overloads for common shapes, e.g., request(path, body?: unknown): Promise<Record<string, any>> for JS users.
```

maria: That helps, but we have a sample that uses `await client.request('/embed', {q})` and gets `unknown` returned so IDE autocomplete is dead.
sam: add a typed helper in samples: `const embed = await client.request<{embedding:number[]}>(...)` but that's asking users to annotate.

eli: alternative — supply small `typed` wrapper in SDK: `client.json<T = unknown>(...)` and `client.any(...)` for JS users.

maria: Also observed edge runtime error: "self is not defined" from a polyfill used in cjs shim. I think bundler injected it when encountering `globalThis` fallback during conditional export.

jun: ok immediate fix for sample: 1) switch sample package.json to only import ESM export (no conditional CJS export), 2) set tsconfig.moduleResolution to `node16` (bundlers handle it better), 3) add a tiny readme note about typing helpers. 

maria: I'll try that. One more ask: can we add a lint rule or dev CI step that builds the edge sample targeting ESM and runs it in a local edge runtime (vercel dev/deno)? This would catch these shims early.

sam: +1. devx-bot can we add a check? @devx-bot any chance to add a quick workflow?

devx-bot: created issue #1221: "edge-samples: build and smoke-test ESM-only sample in edge runtime" with labels devex/ci and priority/medium. Assigned to @maria.

maria: thanks! I'll open a tiny PR to change exports and add typed wrapper helpers. Will ping once CI green.

eli: thanks — also add a short note in SDK changelog: "avoid conditional exports in edge-only samples". Saves folks a day.

sam: If PR touches typings, please include the small sample usage snippet to show IDE inference improvement. Otherwise reviewers will question.

maria: will do. cc @jun for review on the typing overload shape.
